track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 10: Shekasteh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Shekasteh in Bayat-e Tork, Mahur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis. Tonic named Bk: Alizadeh's setar sits within about 20 cents of A440 across his radif albums, so this finalis is a real B koron, not a natural note on an instrument tuned away from A440.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on Fk in Shekasteh. The line peaks at Ds5 (588.5 Hz) at 0:34.0. It closes on the tonic (As4 → As4 → As4 → As4 → C5 → B4).
